title: St. Charles County residents sentenced to federal prison after guilty pleas in forced labor case - NewsBreak
text:
5 hours ago ST. LOUIS, Mo. (First Alert 4) - Three St. Charles County residents have been sentenced to federal prison for their roles in a forced labor case. Venkatesh Sattaru, 38, was sentenced Thursday to 50 months in prison. This sentence is to run concurrently with a five-year sentence he received in state court for a domestic assault charge. Sattaru had pleaded guilty to confiscating or concealing immigration paperwork while obtaining the labor or services of a person by means of serious harm or threats of serious harm and theft of government funds.
